description: Search Hindsight: published technology forecasts (IMF, OECD, Gartner, MIT Technology Review, Kurzweil and others) graded against what happened. Search by subject, e.g. 'quantum computing'. Each subject lists its forecasts with publisher, year and verdict. Use it for base rates before you trust a new forecast. Read one forecast with get_hindsight_claim.
name: search_hindsight
title: Search graded forecasts
